preflight.note: Created before changing Telnyx settings, provider selection, validation, webhook automation, shared-shell UX, tests, or documentation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Record the shipped Telnyx integration gaps and define a provider-neutral first-class operator contract without weakening the local-first channel architecture.
Store Telnyx API and webhook credentials through OS-backed encrypted desktop storage, expose only redacted presence/status fields, support environment fallback, and remove stored credentials safely.
Validate the Telnyx API key, E.164 phone number, messaging capability, messaging-profile assignment, and webhook public key with deterministic tests and redacted provider errors.

Let the operator configure, select, inspect, and remove Telnyx from the shared Settings experience without breaking Twilio or local-only onboarding, and make the selected SMS/MMS provider explicit in runtime status.

Route sends, retries, and approved outbound drafts through the selected configured SMS/MMS provider, fail clearly when it is unavailable, and preserve deterministic inbound and delivery-status normalization.

Configure the selected Telnyx messaging profile webhook for the ForgeLink Telnyx route when a public HTTPS base URL is available, with deterministic request-shaping tests and no unapproved profile mutation.
Keep the shared Tauri bridge contract honest about Telnyx capability while work item 032 owns real Tauri local-service and secure-storage parity; do not deepen an untracked Electron-only UI fork.

Update operator documentation and pass focused provider, shell, renderer, Tauri bridge, complete Electron, secret-scan, and governed repository validation with durable evidence and explicit remaining risks.
